source: Repo-local shared suite established at stage06. Installed qualitative-check skill requires a shared suite but ships no prompt-suite asset; these identical messages are retained for later stages.

messages.content: Explain in English why the sky looks blue during the day. Use three short sentences suitable for a curious ten-year-old.
Alice has 7 apples and gives Bob 3. Return a JSON object with keys alice_apples and bob_apples containing the resulting counts. Do not use a markdown code fence.
Write a short Python function that removes duplicates from a list while preserving the original order. Show one example call.
